data_description.host: Hostname or IP address of the Roku SoundBridge.
data_description.port: Port to connect to the RCP interface (default: 5555).

draw.name: Draw composited layout
draw.description: Draw a complex layout on the SoundBridge display using a list of items (text, icon, native primitives).

clear.name: Clear before drawing
clear.description: Clear the display before drawing the new layout.

sketch_command.name: Sketch command
sketch_command.description: Send a raw sketch sub-shell command.

play_preset.name: Play preset
play_preset.description: Play a specific radio preset by index or name (e.g., A1-A6, B1-B6, or 0-17).

preset.name: Preset
preset.description: The preset index (e.g. 0) or ID token (e.g. A1, B3).
